name: Wall sit

phases.name: set
phases.cue: Back flat on the wall, slide down

phases.name: sit
phases.cue: Thighs level, knees over your ankles

phases.name: breathe
phases.cue: Press your back into the wall and breathe steadily

formTips: Stand with your back against a wall and your feet about hip-width apart, a step out from it
Slide down until your thighs are level with the floor and your knees are bent at 90°
Keep your knees right over your ankles, not past your toes
Press your lower back, upper back and head flat against the wall
Keep your weight in your heels and breathe steadily for the whole hold
commonMistakes: Feet too close to the wall, so the knees drift past the toes
Sitting too high, with the thighs well above level
Resting your hands on your thighs to push yourself up
Letting the knees cave in towards each other
